reviewer: Amp local source and counterexample review; not independent external review
review_scope: Current Order and structured Configuration integration, limited to the exact typed contracts and explicitly retained application gates.

findings.resolution: Order is a member Set plus a bounded metalinguistic pair extension, not a classifier asserting every pair is an actual Relation. OC-D1 proves extensional identity, partial-order laws, strict-part recovery and converse construction. OC-C1 separates partial from total orders, excludes nonmembers, inhabits empty orders and exhibits an asymmetric nontransitive Direction.

D046 retains organon:Order under Coordination Order; D122 uses organon:MathematicalOrder. Canonical institutional references use the new label, existing anchors and glyph slots retain their meaning, and legacy Lean Order indices are not repurposed.

Entity is the Presence reidentified across ordered States, not an extensionally fixed snapshot or a growing history record. OC-D3 and OC-C3 show one witness across unequal structured States; an additional State satisfies the same Invariant but is not in its history. This blocks the inference from common invariant to history membership.

OC-D2 and OC-C2 distinguish State index and structure. OC-D4 and OC-C2 retain Boundary associations with an external non-Constraint participant, while equal finite Constraint projections lose those associations. OC-D5 and OC-C4 retain the Model join, Denotation, actual Transformation endpoints and permitted Constraints in one concrete pipeline.

Interpretation predicates are supplied. The core Constraint is still a predicate shadow; the Model pipeline uses supplied Perception/Memory functions and Constraints rather than deriving canonical conditions. Empirical Entity Identity, actual ordered pairs and full downstream parity remain OC-G1, not claims established by Lean.

The source and typed manifests explicitly mark nonbinding shadows and local proof boundaries. The full 58-job build and finite executable passed. Existing APIs remain unchanged. Current counts and build receipt distinguish current verification from historical evidence; no passing check is treated as empirical or glyph-reader certification.

The three prior Aesthetics failures are adjudicated in the dossier against downloaded logs and source history. Persistent-Configuration ambiguity is corrected; append-only and calibrated-status judgments lack a specific supported violation in the retained evidence, whose whole-PR input was truncated. Historical reviews are preserved, and no CI rule or threshold is relaxed. A new CI result remains separate evidence.
